items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1959-09-01
items.q: Did Morris Rouse ever work with him?

ctx.x: Well, we had two, three, had a girl. That girl I told him about went nuts, Laura. Laura. Made her a long time. Then we had a fellow named Brownie, Clowns Brownie. Oh, two, three piano players. They didn't keep no good piano. Oh yeah, the boy died. James, James from Atlanta, Georgia. Johnson, James P. No, James, put James down, I'll call his name. He was a dope thing, he died. Not James, James, James from Atlanta, Georgia. Johnson, James P. No, James, put James down, I'll call his name. He was a dope thing till he…
Did Morris Rouse ever work with him? Who? Morris Rouse, Rouse, what can I pronounce it, Rouse or Rouse? Never knew him, huh?
Hemingway, James Hemingway. Hemingway. Yeah, James Hemingway. Now he was a good piano player.
